preset-catalogue.christmas.bauble-sway.note: Name of a ready-made animation preset in the Christmas group: a tree ornament (bauble) swinging gently.

preset-catalogue.christmas.fairy-light-g.note: Name of an animation preset in the Christmas group: a string of small decorative lights glowing.

preset-catalogue.christmas.golden-star-s.note: Name of an animation preset in the Christmas group: golden stars falling like rain.

preset-catalogue.christmas.jingle-bell.note: Name of an animation preset in the Christmas group: a bell that rings back and forth.

preset-catalogue.christmas.new-year-fire.note: Name of an animation preset in the Christmas group: fireworks bursting for New Year's Eve.

preset-catalogue.christmas.present-hop.note: Name of an animation preset in the Christmas group: a gift box that hops. Present means gift here, not now.

preset-catalogue.christmas.snow-that-set.note: Name of an animation preset in the Christmas group: snowfall that piles up and stays.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.dishwasher-ste.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: steam rising from a dishwasher.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.fresh-sparkle.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: small stars that twinkle to show something is clean.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.robot-vacuum-g.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: a robot vacuum cleaner gliding across the floor.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.soap-bubbles-t.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: soap bubbles that rise and burst.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.spray-mist.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: a fine spray of liquid from a bottle.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.washer-spin-cy.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: a washing machine drum spinning.

preset-catalogue.cleaning.wipe-clean.note: Name of an animation preset in the Cleaning group: a wiping motion that leaves a surface clean. Wipe is a verb.

preset-catalogue.fire.chimney-smoke.note: Name of an animation preset in the Fire group: smoke curling out of a chimney.

preset-catalogue.fire.hearth-flicker.note: Name of an animation preset in the Fire group: flames of a fireplace flickering. Hearth is the floor of a fireplace.

preset-catalogue.fire.heating-up.note: Name of an animation preset in the Fire group: a heater glowing as it warms up.

preset-catalogue.fire.licking-flames.note: Name of an animation preset in the Fire group: flames that flick upward. Licking is figurative, not tasting.

preset-catalogue.fire.rising-embers.note: Name of an animation preset in the Fire group: glowing sparks of a fire drifting up. Embers are hot bits of coal.

preset-catalogue.fire.sparkler.note: Name of an animation preset in the Fire group: a hand-held firework stick that throws sparks.

preset-catalogue.halloween.bat-flight.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: a bat (the animal) flying.

preset-catalogue.halloween.bubbling-caul.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: a witch's pot with bubbling liquid.

preset-catalogue.halloween.creeping-fog.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: fog that spreads slowly along the ground.

preset-catalogue.halloween.ghost-float.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: a ghost drifting up and down. Float is a verb here.

preset-catalogue.halloween.jack-o-lanter.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: a carved pumpkin lantern glowing from inside.

preset-catalogue.halloween.skull-chatter.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: a skull whose jaw clatters. Chatter means rattling teeth.

preset-catalogue.halloween.spider-drop.note: Name of an animation preset in the Halloween group: a spider lowering itself on a thread.

preset-catalogue.home.doorbell-ring.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: a doorbell ringing. Ring is the sound, not a finger ring.

preset-catalogue.home.energy-flow.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: electricity moving along a line, for power or grid readings.

preset-catalogue.home.fan-running.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: a fan with turning blades. Fan is the appliance, not a supporter.

preset-catalogue.home.garden-sprinkler.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: a lawn sprinkler throwing water.

preset-catalogue.home.leak-drip-splash.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: a water leak with a drop falling and splashing. The ampersand joins drip and splash.

preset-catalogue.home.mail-arrived.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: a letter arriving in the mailbox.

preset-catalogue.home.motion-detected.note: Name of an animation preset in the Home group: a motion sensor noticing movement.

preset-catalogue.light.candlelight.note: Name of an animation preset in the Light group: a candle flame flickering.

preset-catalogue.light.lamp-breathe.note: Name of an animation preset in the Light group: a lamp that slowly brightens and dims, like breathing. Breathe is a verb used as a noun.

preset-catalogue.light.lamp-switch-on.note: Name of an animation preset in the Light group: a lamp lighting up when switched on.

preset-catalogue.light.party-sparkle.note: Name of an animation preset in the Light group: colourful lights twinkling like at a party.

preset-catalogue.light.sunbeam-dust.note: Name of an animation preset in the Light group: dust specks floating in a ray of sunlight.

preset-catalogue.light.sunrise-warm-up.note: Name of an animation preset in the Light group: light that slowly turns warm like a sunrise.

preset-catalogue.valentine.blush-glow.note: Name of an animation preset in the Valentine group: a soft pink glow, like blushing cheeks.

preset-catalogue.valentine.cupid-sparkle.note: Name of an animation preset in the Valentine group: sparkles around Cupid's arrow, the god of love.

preset-catalogue.valentine.falling-petal.note: Name of an animation preset in the Valentine group: flower petals drifting down.

preset-catalogue.valentine.floating-hear.note: Name of an animation preset in the Valentine group: heart symbols rising slowly.

preset-catalogue.valentine.heart-burst.note: Name of an animation preset in the Valentine group: a heart symbol that bursts into smaller hearts.

preset-catalogue.valentine.lub-dub-heart.note: Name of an animation preset in the Valentine group: a heart pulsing in the two-beat rhythm of lub-dub, the sound of a heartbeat.
